Plot a map and overlay data and/or geoprofile via leaflet

geoPlotLeaflet.Rd

Plots geoprofile on map, with various customisable options. Interactive and static map options available.

Usage

geoPlotLeaflet(
  params = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  surface = NULL,
  surfaceCols = c("#F0F921FF", "#FDC926FF", "#FA9E3BFF", "#ED7953FF", "#D8576BFF",
    "#BD3786FF", "#9C179EFF", "#7301A8FF", "#47039FFF", "#0D0887FF"),
  threshold = 0.1,
  smoothing = 1,
  opacity = 0.8,
  plotContours = FALSE,
  contourBreaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 11),
  contourCol = "grey50",
  contourWeight = 1,
  contourOpacity = 1,
  crimeCex = 1.5,
  crimeCol = "red",
  sourceCex = 1.5,
  sourceCol = "blue",
  colOpacity = 1,
  mapType = "Esri.WorldImagery",
  apiKey = NULL,
  showBoundary = TRUE,
  boundaryWeight = 2,
  boundaryCol = grDevices::grey(0.2),
  gpLegend = FALSE,
  legendPosition = "bottomright",
  legendScale = 1,
  saveFile = NULL,
  cropToBoundary = TRUE,
  mapZoom = 5,
  saveWidth = 1200,
  saveHeight = 1200,
  saveZoom = 2
)

Arguments

params

parameters list in the format defined by geoParams().

data

data object in the format defined by geoData().

source

potential sources object in the format defined by geoDataSource().

surface

a surface to overlay onto the map, typically a geoprofile obtained from the output of geoMCMC().

surfaceCols

vector of two or more colours to plot surface. Defaults to viridis palette.

threshold

what level of the geoprofile to display. 1 = the whole geoprofile surface. 0.1 = the top 10% of the surface.

smoothing

smoothing affects the plotted resolution of the colour heatmaps. Higher values = more pixels, smoother colour gradients but increased plotting time.

opacity

value between 0 and 1 giving the opacity of surface colours.

plotContours

Another way of viewing the geoprofile surface which uses contour lines to represent the surface as a heightmap.

contourBreaks

hitscore % levels, as in breakPercent. Set the range and bins of the geoprofile surface the contours will represent.

contourCol

colour of contour lines.

contourWeight

thickness of contour lines.

contourOpacity

opacity of contour lines.

crimeCex

relative size of symbols showing crimes.

crimeCol

colour of crime symbols.

sourceCex

relative size of symbols showing suspect sites.

sourceCol

colour of suspect sites symbols.

colOpacity

opacity of crime and source colours.

mapType

the specific type of map to plot. See leaflet::providers for options.

apiKey

API keys may be required for some maptypes. Note: API keys for Carto maps will not work with the current leaflet package version available on CRAN.

showBoundary

plot a bounding box that encompasses the extent of the geoprofile surface.

boundaryWeight

thickness of the bounding box.

boundaryCol

colour of the boundary box.

gpLegend

whether or not to add legend to plot.

legendPosition

"bottomright", # "topright", "bottomright", "bottomleft", "topleft".

legendScale

size of the legend.

saveFile

take a static screenshot of the plot for figures. UI such as the zoom options are automatically removed. Set by inputting a name for the resulting file.

cropToBoundary

crop so that the saved figure matches the extent of the geoprofile surface.

mapZoom

control the zoom of the plot. Ignored if cropToBoundary = TRUE.

saveWidth

set the width of the resulting saved image.

saveHeight

set the height of the resulting saved image.

saveZoom

does not affect the zoom of the map but instead affects the resolution of the saved image. Affects the zoom option of the function webshot2::webshot.

Value

A leaflet plot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# London example data
d <- LondonExample_crimes
s <- LondonExample_sources
p <- geoParams(data = d, sigma_mean = 1.0, sigma_squared_shape = 2)
m <- geoMCMC(data = d, params = p)
# produce simple map
geoPlotLeaflet(params = p,
               data = d,
               source = s,
               surface = m$geoProfile,
               crimeCol = "black",
               crimeCex = 2,
               sourceCol = "red",
               sourceCex = 2)

# John Snow cholera data
d <- Cholera
s <- WaterPumps
p <- geoParams(data = d, sigma_mean = 1.0, sigma_squared_shape = 2)
m <- geoMCMC(data = d, params = p, lambda=0.05)
# produce simple map
geoPlotLeaflet(params = p,
               data = d,
               source = s,
               surface = m$geoProfile,
               crimeCol = "black",
               crimeCex = 2,
               sourceCol = "red",
               sourceCex = 2)

# simulated data
sim <-rDPM(50, priorMean_longitude = -0.04217491, priorMean_latitude =
51.5235505, alpha=1, sigma=1, tau=3)
d <- geoData(sim$longitude, sim $latitude)
s <- geoDataSource(sim$source_lon, sim$source_lat)
p <- geoParams(data = d, sigma_mean = 1.0, sigma_squared_shape = 2)
m <- geoMCMC(data = d, params = p)
# change colour palette, map type, opacity and range of geoprofile and omit legend
geoPlotLeaflet(params = p,
               data = d,
               source = s,
               surface = m$geoProfile,
               surfaceCols = c("blue","white"),
               crimeCol = "black",
               crimeCex = 2,
               sourceCol = "red",
               sourceCex = 2,
               opacity = 0.7,
               gpLegend = FALSE)
} # }
}
